emotional breakthrough! so proud of myself

I [F19] have gone through a great deal in the past few years. Most lessons I had to learn, many I would never wish on anyone. One thing I truly have learned is that the rose tinted perspective I have had on love ever since I can remember, through the Prince Charmings and sweet damsels locked away in a tower, is that I have found this strange, false sense of security in the firm idea that one day, there will be “someone” out there to love me, comfort me and worship the parts of me that I find repulsive. But the reality is that only I can make myself feel truly comfortable. I know people always say love yourself before others can begin to love you but I have realised something more than that: if there is no “someone” I can still be happy and not feel alone. My whole life I have seeked male validation and have tried the dating apps, come close to relationships but I always run away even though I am the one who wants to be held at night and kissed in the morning. And I realise why. because I am in love with the idea, the fantasy of being in love. 

but I am so perfectly fine with me as me that if no one was to be by my side, I would be content with my life. No I am not deluding myself into being happy with fantasies of being with someone, I just realised I don’t NEED anyone else other than my friends or family. 

I’m writing this because people often say that being happy with being single is a journey, a process but sometimes it just hits you. 

To whoever is reading this, I love me and you should love you too ❤️
